01-a-line-cocktail-dress-mannequin.jpg.details: Long-sleeve V-neck dress with natural waist seam, waist darts, and an asymmetric diagonal pleated flounce/ruffle draped over a straight midi skirt; likely wool crepe with a back zipper.

02-ball-gown-exhibit.jpg.details: Antique Edwardian-style couture evening gown with beaded lace overlay bodice, empire waist marked by a jeweled/beaded sash, sheer lace short sleeves, and a slim maxi satin skirt with vertical beaded floral embroidery; approximated the elaborate beaded panels as princess seaming and the fitted column as a straight skirt.

04-babydoll-dress.jpg.details: Drop-waist wool dress with knife-pleated mini skirt, scalloped white contrast collar and cuffs, small front tie/bow, and welt pocket details at hip; approximated dropped waist as natural waistline.

05-empire-waist-gown.jpg.details: 18th-century robe à la française approximated as a fitted princess-seam bodice with square neckline, elbow-length engageantes sleeves, and open gathered maxi overskirt revealing a satin petticoat; heavily trimmed with ruched silk and floral passementerie; boned corseted structure simplified to princess seams.

10-tiered-ruffle-dress.jpg.details: Antique tiered dress with crochet lace band threaded with blue ribbon, finely pleated sheer cotton/linen ruffles; approximated as dress with pleated skirt and tiered ruffles; neckline/sleeves not visible in crop.

11-flamenco-dress-ruffles.jpg.details: Flamenco-style gown approximated as fitted bodice with princess seams, natural waist, and a mermaid silhouette with multiple tiered red-and-black ruffle flounces; fabric appears to be black lace with contrasting ruffle trim.

13-keyhole-neckline-dress.jpg.details: Chinese cheongsam-style top with mandarin collar, decorative frog closures, teardrop keyhole at front, sleeveless armholes, and floral brocade satin fabric; approximated as fitted top with darts.

14-v-neck-dress-mannequin.jpg.details: Golden satin evening gown with beaded floral embroidery on collar and skirt panels; approximated as princess-seamed bodice with natural waist seam and A-line maxi skirt, sweetheart neckline framed by a wide portrait-style collar.
